current_version.description: the version the owner runs, as the project tags it

latest_version.description: the newest release found; the version in use when it could not be found (verdict incomplete)

latest_date.description: when the newest release was published

verdict.description: up_to_date: nothing newer; safe: every release in between read in full and none touches an item; changes_needed: a release changes something an item names; incomplete: a release in between was not read or read in part, never safe

repeat.description: true when nothing was released since the last run and its result is answered again without re-reading the notes

versions.description: each release after the version in use whose notes were read, newest first; empty for up_to_date

source_url.description: the page its notes were read from

read.description: partial: a slice cut its notes and the rest was not read

findings.description: each change that touches an item on the owner's list

change.description: what changes, in the release note's own words

affects.description: the item it touches, in the owner's words

what_to_do.description: the note's migration step; when it gives none, what the change implies, starting "Not stated in the notes:"

source_url.description: the page that shows the change

confidence.description: high: the note names the item itself; medium: it names the item's parent; low: the match is the agent's reading

other_breaking.description: breaking changes in the releases read that touch nothing on the list, one line each with its version

unread.description: each release in between whose notes were not read; not empty means the verdict is incomplete

reason.description: blocked: a rate limit or an access-denied answer; not_found: no notes for it; error: a timeout or server error; skipped: the fetch budget was spent

unreachable.description: each page the plan needed and could not read, with why

reason.description: blocked: a rate limit or an access-denied answer; not_found: no notes for it; error: a timeout or server error; skipped: the fetch budget was spent

detail.description: what the page answered, in a few words: "rate limited (403)", "timed out"

summary.description: the report as a person reads it: the range, the verdict, each finding with what to do, what was not read
